summary: Captures process-oriented evidence governance requirements, quality expectations, ownership, traceability, approval evidence, exception evidence, and graduation evidence expectations for Project Nile.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). This document does not define obligations directly enforceable from resource_changes or other Terraform plan fields.

controls.title: Evidence must be collected before approval
controls.obligation: Evidence must be collected, linked, and reviewable before an approval decision is made.
controls.rationale: Requires evidence collection state, linkage, and human approval workflow context not present in Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Evidence must be traceable to a source
controls.obligation: Every evidence item must be traceable to a source such as a pull request, document, review record, or GitHub reference.
controls.rationale: Traceability to review records and GitHub references is a governance record concern, not a Terraform resource attribute.

controls.title: Evidence must be reviewable
controls.obligation: Evidence must be accessible to reviewers in a form that permits human evaluation.
controls.rationale: Human accessibility and reviewability cannot be determined from a Terraform plan.

controls.title: GitHub is the system of record for evidence
controls.source_section: Section 2 – GitHub As System Of Record
controls.obligation: Pull requests, review comments, approval records, and linked documents in GitHub constitute the evidence trace for governance review.
controls.rationale: Requires repository workflow and review-history data outside Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Exceptions require supporting evidence
controls.obligation: Exception requests must include business justification, technical justification, risk assessment, and compensating controls evidence.
controls.rationale: Exception request completeness is process evidence, not plan-inspectable infrastructure state.

controls.title: Evidence quality requirements must be satisfied
controls.obligation: Evidence should be traceable, reviewable, linked, current, relevant, complete, versioned, and auditable.
controls.rationale: Quality attributes apply to evidence artifacts and governance records rather than Terraform resource configuration.

controls.title: Approval evidence must be traceable to a named human reviewer
controls.source_section: Section 7 – Required Evidence Categories; Section 10 – Approval Evidence Model
controls.obligation: Approval records for production-impacting changes must be traceable to a named human reviewer and linked to supporting evidence.
controls.rationale: Human approval identity and review trace are not expressed in Terraform plan resource_changes.

controls.title: Gate evaluations require category-specific evidence packages
controls.obligation: Each production readiness gate requires specified evidence categories such as IaC references, validation findings, exceptions, metadata validation, and approval records.
controls.rationale: Gate evidence packages span documents, reviews, approvals, and findings outside Terraform plan content.

controls.title: Graduation evidence must span prior lifecycle stages
controls.obligation: The graduation evidence package must assemble traceable, reviewable evidence across all applicable prior gates and lifecycle stages.
controls.rationale: Cross-stage evidence assembly is a governance process requirement, not a plan-time resource property.

controls.title: Evidence must remain GitHub-indexed and auditable over time
controls.obligation: Evidence should be linked, discoverable, traceable to source and decision, GitHub-indexed, revision-stable, and auditable over time.
controls.rationale: Indexing, discoverability, and long-term auditability depend on external records and repositories, not Terraform plan fields.

controls.title: Evidence status is informational and human-governed
controls.obligation: Evidence items may be Draft, Collected, Under Review, Accepted, Rejected, Expired, or Archived, and status does not imply approval authority.
controls.rationale: Evidence lifecycle status is a governance workflow state absent from Terraform plans.

controls.title: Validation agents evaluate evidence but do not approve
controls.obligation: Validation agents may verify evidence existence and quality gaps but must not approve readiness, exceptions, or production-impacting changes.
controls.rationale: Agent authority boundaries are procedural guidance, not infrastructure attributes in plan JSON.
